metadata.description: Nine skills for Claude Code: intelligent model routing, running several skills at once, persistent goal loops, and keeping an assistant honest about what it has actually checked.

plugins.name: midesparks-skills
plugins.description: Nine skills built while running a live production app solo. auto-model: score a task and route it to the right Claude model, then explain the routing. merge: run several skills together as one unified execution rather than in sequence. goal: keep working until a success condition is actually met, not until one attempt finishes. model / compact: manual model selection and context compression. check-first: read the artefact that defines a mechanism before explaining it or handing over a procedure. deep-check: audit an entire existing project line by line without faking completeness. release-audit: verify a release actually contains what you think before it reaches users. layman-explain: explain technical, legal and financial things plainly without softening the real risk.
